metadata.title: Dynamic Method Dispatch via Server-Controlled targetFunction String — Prototype Chain Hijack

sources: KeyboardMappings.json targetFunction string (static asset — server-side or CDN-tampered)
sinks: this.jsFunc[methodName](param) — bracket-notation dispatch on IJSFunctionService instance

privilege_boundary.start_privilege: Attacker controlling KeyboardMappings.json or ApplinX server response
privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Arbitrary JavaScript execution in user browser via Function constructor (eval-equivalent)

impact.description: IMMEDIATE FIX REQUIRED. Prototype chain traversal enables Function constructor invocation: this.jsFunc['constructor']['constructor']('malicious code')() = full eval. CVSS 8.0 HIGH confirmed. Attack chain VULN-002 → VULN-008: steal sessionStorage token and hijack session.

remediation.fix_approach: FIXED: hasOwnProperty guard blocks prototype chain hijack in keyboard dispatch. sendKeys allowlist added.

attack_chains: VULN-002 → VULN-008: eval → sessionStorage token exfil → session hijack
